entries.text: About to head into a Saturday night dinner shift . I ' m looking forward to being of service , not looking forward to the guests who don ' t know how to fine out and plan to treat me like their slave rather than their host .

Energized , ready for my last shift of the week . Grateful that I have 2 days in a row off and that I have a job that pays as well as it does . Hopefully tonight will be smooth and by the numbers , that the kitchen performs well and that the guests are easy going .

I am off today and tomorrow . I spoke with my therapist for my weekly session which is always great because I get to unpack my mind which helps me find balance and a place of calm contentment . Tonight I plan to make dinner with my daughter and her husbsnd and open a nice bottle of wine and relax with all the dogs .
